filter.description: Filter used to decide whether a particular cloud message belongs to this CloudMessageDispatcher

batchSize.description: Number of messages to pull from CloudMessageBroker in each receiveMessages call

subBatchSize.description:
subBatchSize.

During dispatching, the #batchSize of message taken from the broker is further divided into sub-batches
of size #subBatchSize to be processed in parallel.

timeoutMillis.description: Time in milliseconds receiver waits for the next event before receiver stops listening.

cloudConsumer.description: Name of cloud consumer or group used to read messages

partition.description: The partition of the CloudMessageBroker that receiveMessages reads data from

ignoreBadContent.description: If true will silently ignore bad syntax in the content abd continue to next message.

skipExtraFields.description: Optionally skip extra fields in serialized content instead of failing to serialize.

contentTypeOverride.description: This overrides the media type of the content.

contentEncodingOverride.description: This overrides the encoding type of the content.

cloudMessageBrokerName.description:
Name of the underlying queue to be created / referenced ({@link CloudResource}).
If this field is left undefined, the name of the queue will be defined by a configuration defined by the name
of the type found on the corresponding tag.

cloudMessageBrokerType.description:
Type of cloud message broker that is a {@link CloudMessageBroker}.
    e.g. {@link AzureEventHub}, {@link AwsKinesis}, {@link ApacheKafkaTopic}, {@link AwsSqs}.
